models.composition: Statue of Silenus — Unknown Roman sculptor
models.qualification: Actually matched exact face, crown, beard curls, textured chest and belly, genitals, drapery and historical limb breaks to the Narbo Via primary collection photograph and a full on-site photograph by Skopien. The existing catalog Silenus with Infant Dionysus and Fitzwilliam double herm are distinct compositions. The exact model UID appears in prior other-chat discovery only, with no source acquisition found. Preserve fragment condition; do not reconstruct missing arms, feet or hands, and distinguish museum mounting from ancient work. The source dates late 1st/2nd century; accession 856.5.5 appears only in secondary data and is not asserted in this draft. Native reverse, fracture surfaces, mounting pins and base boundary still require review. Current exact-model metadata is downloadable CC BY 4.0 and explicitly isAiGenerated:false. ROOT adult body curation, authenticated retrieval, native quality, paired review and archive coverage remain pending.
